algorithmic_analysis.keyer_type: Differential Chrominance Separation (Nuke Keyer / Difference model)
advantages: Clean extraction for even studio backings
Zero training or complex setup required
Full RGBA and tiled buffer support
known_limitations: Not equivalent to Primatte 3D convex polyhedral colour space partitioning
Not equivalent to Keylight's screen-weight colour model and continuous edge balance
Does not support synthetic background subtraction (IBKCleanPlate / IBKGizmo)
Challenging on uneven lighting or extreme motion blur with shadow noise
algorithmic_analysis.classification: FULL (for standard differential chroma keying) / BASIC (relative to Primatte/Keylight)
